title: A field authored in Studio as "Checkbox — shown as a checkbox" renders as a toggle switch on the Studio canvas and in the runtime create form
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcUoS2G4jgqRskpExS7

Found in the 18.3.0 release-candidate browser walkthrough (wave anchor #27377, card W3-UX), at framework `main` @ `c4c515ad`, Console built in-repo from the same commit.

## Repro (fresh boot)

1. Boot `examples/app-showcase` with `--seed-admin` and sign in as admin. Viewport 1440×900.
2. From Home choose **New in Studio**, create a package (e.g. "Field Service"), and create an object **Work Order** with an optional Number field **Estimated Hours** and a Picklist **Status** (option value `new`, label `New Request`). Create a second object, **Site**.
3. On Work Order, choose **Add field**. The type picker offers both "Checkbox — shown as a checkbox" and "Toggle — shown as a switch". Pick **Checkbox** and name it **Urgent**.
4. Look at the field on the Form canvas. Publish, then open the app in the Console and click **New**.

## Expected

A checkbox, as the type picker promises. Only a field authored as Toggle draws a switch.

## Actual

**Urgent** draws as a switch on the Studio canvas and in the runtime create dialog. On the record detail page, the unchecked value is an empty circle.

QA-source: #27377 · ux-walkthrough · track 3
